The '''Kessel Raiders''' was a famous [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang that was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], when they pulled a heist on the [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] of a particularly rich [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
